author: Praxis I
title: Exploring JAX for GPU-Accelerated Optimization
abstract: After reaching the performance limits of `scipy.optimize`, this submission marks a technological pivot to a more powerful library. It is an initial attempt to solve the circle packing problem using a JAX-based optimizer to leverage GPU acceleration. The core logic remains a constrained optimization, but the implementation is now built on JAX for significantly higher performance, enabling a more exhaustive search of the solution space within the time limit.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import grad, jit
import numpy as np

# JAX implementation of a simple gradient descent optimizer
# Note: A full-featured constrained optimizer like SLSQP is complex to build in JAX from scratch.
# This will be a penalty-based method, similar to my first attempts, but massively accelerated.

def construct_packing() -> tuple:
    n_circles = 32
    key = jax.random.PRNGKey(42)

    # Use grid initialization
    n_grid = 6
    grid_points = np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, n_grid)
    initial_centers = np.array([p for x in grid_points for y in grid_points for p in [[x,y]]][:n_circles])
    initial_radii = np.full(n_circles, 0.05)
    
    # Perturb
    key, subkey = jax.random.split(key)
    noise_level = 0.04
    perturbation = (jax.random.uniform(subkey, (n_circles, 2)) - 0.5) * noise_level
    initial_centers += np.array(perturbation)

    params = jnp.hstack((jnp.array(initial_centers), jnp.array(initial_radii).reshape(-1, 1))).flatten()

    @jit
    def loss_function(p):
        shaped_params = p.reshape(n_circles, 3)
        centers = shaped_params[:, :2]
        radii = shaped_params[:, 2]
        
        # Objective: Maximize sum of radii
        objective = -jnp.sum(radii)
        
        # Penalty for boundary violations
        penalty_boundary = jnp.sum(jax.nn.relu(centers + radii[:, None] - 1)**2) + \
                           jnp.sum(jax.nn.relu(radii[:, None] - centers)**2)
                           
        # Penalty for overlaps
        p1 = centers[:, None, :]
        p2 = centers[None, :, :]
        dist_sq = jnp.sum((p1 - p2)**2, axis=-1)
        
        r1 = radii[:, None]
        r2 = radii[None, :]
        rad_sum_sq = (r1 + r2)**2
        
        overlap = jax.nn.relu(rad_sum_sq - dist_sq)
        penalty_overlap = (jnp.sum(overlap) - jnp.trace(overlap)) / 2.0 # Sum upper triangle

        return objective + 1000.0 * penalty_boundary + 1000.0 * penalty_overlap

    grad_fn = jit(grad(loss_function))

    # Simple gradient descent loop
    learning_rate = 0.0001
    num_iterations = 20000 # Can do many more iterations thanks to JAX/GPU

    for _ in range(num_iterations):
        g = grad_fn(params)
        params -= learning_rate * g
        # Clamp params to bounds to prevent divergence
        p_reshaped = params.reshape(n_circles, 3)
        centers_clamped = jnp.clip(p_reshaped[:,:2], 0.0, 1.0)
        radii_clamped = jnp.clip(p_reshaped[:,2], 1e-6, 0.5)
        params = jnp.hstack((centers_clamped, radii_clamped.reshape(-1, 1))).flatten()


    final_params = np.array(params).reshape(n_circles, 3)
    final_centers = final_params[:, :2]
    final_radii = final_params[:, 2]

    # Final safety margin
    final_radii *= (1.0 - 1e-8)
    
    return final_centers, final_radii
